info.title: MediShield Document Intake API
info.description: Multi-agent claims intake: upload, classify, extract, verify, check policy, score fraud, decide - with human review, four-eyes approval and a tamper-evident audit log.

get.description: Public: whether the local demo passwords (<user>-demo) exist, so the sign-in page knows what its role buttons can do.
Behind Lambda a request may carry at most 6 MB, so on AWS files go straight to S3 and the API reads them from there.

post.description: Create a case from files the browser uploaded with /cases/uploads. Only the caller's own upload prefix is read.

get.description: Error Level Analysis heatmap for a JPEG document (computed on demand; other file types have no compression history).
New events since ``after`` plus the case status, in one cheap call (for UIs that poll instead of streaming).

schema.title: Response Case Events Cases  Case Id  Events Get

get.description: Server-Sent Events fallback for environments that block WebSockets.
Cases awaiting a human decision, most urgent first: SLA breached, then fraud risk, then oldest.

schema.title: Response Review Queue Review Queue Get
Response List Overrides Cases  Case Id  Overrides Get

get.description: Published evaluation scorecards (written by ``make eval``; committed under docs/eval_results).
KPIs for the dashboard: throughput, straight-through-processing, speed, cost and projected savings.
What this user's role may ask about, for the chat page (the same map the assistant enforces).

post.description:
Start the assistant (and load its search models) before the first question. No model call, no cost.

AgentCore gives every session its own microVM, so this warms the session the conversation will use.

delete.description: Delete everything the assistant remembers about the caller (conversations, facts, preferences).

post.description:
Create a case from the PDF/PNG/JPEG/TIFF attachments of one email, owned by the caller. The From address must be
on the intake allow-list (``INTAKE_SENDERS``), and a submitter may only send mail from an address mapped to them.
Idempotent on the Message-ID: the same message again returns the first case (200).

case_id.title: Case Id
case_id.description: asked from this case's page: the question is about it (access is still checked)

language.title: Language
language.description: detected script/language of the page: en, es, hi

confirmed.title: Confirmed
confirmed.description: mean AI confidence where the human kept the AI decision

overridden.title: Overridden
overridden.description: mean AI confidence where the human changed it

grounded.title: Grounded
grounded.description: value fuzzy-matches OCR text on the page

corroborated.title: Corroborated
corroborated.description: value matches the system of record (member DB) even if OCR could not read it

reference_date.title: Reference Date
reference_date.description: date of service used for expiry checks

sharpness.title: Sharpness
sharpness.description: variance of the Laplacian on a normalised-size greyscale image

quality_score.title: Quality Score
quality_score.description: 0-1 evidence score combining sharpness and OCR confidence

since.title: Since
since.description: cohort start (cases created on or after); null for all time

applied_override_rate.title: Applied Override Rate
applied_override_rate.description: decided cases with an applied override / cases decided

median_hours_to_final.title: Median Hours To Final
median_hours_to_final.description: case creation to the applied override that finalised it

requested.title: Requested
requested.description: override requests with this reason, whatever their outcome

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: the AI decision this rule produces

overridden.title: Overridden
overridden.description: of those, cases with an applied override

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: of those, cases whose final human decision differs from the AI's
